daily_wisdom: The market rewards decisiveness, not hope. You already decided your stop loss before you bought — now honor that decision without negotiation when the price hits it. The best traders I have watched over 30 years have one thing in common: they cut losers at their predetermined stop with zero emotion, then hunt the next setup. It is not the winners that define your account — it is how small you keep the losers.
